Press G (or 📱) for your phone: goals, a taxi, the bank, your cars and businesses. Buy a shop, a buka or a filling station: it earns while you’re away. Collect before the till fills. Open the map with P and tap anywhere: in a car, a driver will take you there. Naija Rail runs from Meadowbrook to Benin. Skylink flies Lagos to Ibadan and Benin. Rain moves across the country: Benin and the coast get the most, Oyo the least.

          NaijLife

          Left thumb moves, right thumb looks around; at the wheel, ◀ ▶ steer and GAS and BRAKE drive. Indoors, pinch to zoom and drag two fingers up or down to tilt the view. JUMP, then hold it in the air to jet, and tap the gold button to talk, drive or ride the lift. ☰ has the map and everything else; tap the minimap for the big map.

          Turn your device sideways for the best view.

          Buy land: yellow squares on the map are for sale. Stand on one and press E (BUY on touch). The gated estates, Lekki Gardens north of the city and Eastwood Park past the airport, have level plots ready to build on. Bulldozers are sold at Meadowbrook Machinery on the coast road.

          Jet through trees a hundred metres tall on your gas pack, build speed, and cut titans at the nape. The faster you hit, the deeper the cut. They never stop coming.
